africa-day: (Ekugubheni Usuku lwe-Afrika lwama-25, Lolu Hlelo Lokuqeqesha i-Pi Pioneers luyethulwa)
memorial-text:
Isikhungo lesi seMfundo sinikelwe kudadewethu omkhulu esithandekayo Christina Muzheki Manjengwa owaphumula ngo-8 Agasti 2026 wabuye wangcwatshelwa ngo-11 Agasti okunguMholo Wez Heroes weZimbabwe.
Uthando lwakho, isiqondiso namandla akho kuqhubeka kukhuthaza umgomo wethu wokuqinisa i-Afrika.
Ngunaphakade ezinhliziyweni zethu. Phumula ngamandla, Dadewethu.
intro-p1: I-Pi Network yimali yedijithali kanye nephrojekthi ye-ecosystem yomhlaba eyenzelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifinyeleleke futhi ibe usizo kuwo wonke umuntu.
intro-p2: Ngokungafani namanye ama-cryptocurrency adinga imishini yokumba ebizayo, i-Pi Network ivumela abantu abavamile ukuthi babambe iqhaza ngqo kusuka kumafoni abo.
intro-list:
• Yakha umnotho wedijithali obandakanya wonke umuntu ngaphandle kwamabhange
  • Nika amandla abantu abavamile emhlabeni wonke ngokumba kwefoni
  • Khulisa ukusetshenziswa kwangempela ngokusebenzisa ama-utility nama-DApps
  • Sekela ukuhweba komuntu nomuntu futhi unciphise izindleko
  • Yakhiwe ngama-Stanford PhDs - uDkt. Nicolas Kokkalis noDkt. Chengdiao Fan
  • Ngaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-60 zamaphayona emhlabeni wonke
ch1-p2: Isinyathelo 2: Bhalisa nge-Facebook noma Ngefoni → Faka ikhodi: CHIGALEX1 → Thola umvuzo we-1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ukumba Kwansuku Zonke: Buya njalo ngamahora angu-24 bese uchofoza inkinobho yombani ukuze uqhubeke nokumba.
ch1-list2:
• Ungasebenzisi igama mbumbulu - kufanele lihambisane ne-ID ye-KYC
  • Ungadali ama-akhawunti amaningi - umuntu oyedwa i-akhawunti eyodwa
  • Setha i-alamu yokumba njalo ngamahora angu-24 ukuze ugcine izinga
  • Joyina umbuthano wezokuphepha ngemuva kwezinsuku ezi-3 nabantu abathembekile abangu-5
ch1-list:
• Dala isikhwama semali se-Pi ngokuphepha
  • Qedela i-2FA
  • Qedela i-KYC
  • Lungiselela ukufuduka kwe-Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Ukuphepha kwesikhwama: Ungalokothi wabelane ngamagama akho angama-24 e-passphrase! Ithimba le-Pi Core ALISOZE likubuze!
ch2-p1: Isikhwama sakho se-Pi siyibhange lakho ku-Pi Ecosystem. Siphethe izinhlamvu zakho ze-Pi ngokuphepha ku-blockchain.
ch2-p2: Indlela yokudala: Vula i-Pi Browser → Wallet → Dala i-Wallet → KOPIA amagama akho angama-24 → Gcina ungaxhunyiwe ezindaweni ezi-2 eziphephile.
ch2-p3: Ukuthola i-Pi: Yabelana ngekheli lakho lomphakathi (eliqala ngo-G...). Ukuthumela i-Pi: Namathisela ikheli lomamukeli, faka inani, qinisekisa.
ch2-list:
• Bhala i-passphrase ephepheni, hhayi isithombe-skrini
  • Gcina ezindaweni ezi-2 eziphephile ezihlukene (hhayi ifoni kuphela)
  • Hlola nge-1 Pi ngaphambi kokuthumela inani elikhulu
  • Hlola izinhlamvu ezi-4 zokuqala neziyi-4 zokugcina zekheli njalo
ch2a-p1: Okusebenzayo: Qala ngenani elincane lokuhlola (1 Pi). Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlamvu ezi-4 zokuqala neziyi-4 zokugcina zekheli ziyafana. Ungalokothi unamathisele i-passphrase kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi!
ch2a-p2: Ukuzivocavoca Okubukhoma: Kulolu qeqesho, sizokwenza idemo ebukhoma yokuthumela i-1 Pi komunye iphayona ukwakha ukuzethemba. Khumbula: Ukuthengiselana kwe-Blockchain akunakulungiseka!
ch3-p1: I-Pi Browser ifana ne-Google Play Store ye-Pi. Ama-DApps yizinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukaniselwe ukusetshenziswa kwangempela — ukuthenga, imfundo, imidlalo, izinsizakalo zonke zisebenzisa i-Pi.
ch3-list:
• I-Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Inxanxathela yezitolo ye-Pi
  • I-WorkforcePool - Imisebenzi YabaPhayona
  • I-CareForPi - Ukusekelwa kwezempilo
  • I-Chigalex1 Hub - Imfundo (Le App)
  • Futhi nokusetshenziswa okungu-100+ okwengeziwe
ch4-p1: Thola amabhizinisi amukela i-Pi emhlabeni wonke ku-mapofpi.com. Bhalisa ibhizinisi lakho bese uqala ukwamukela i-Pi ngezimpahla namasevisi.
ch4-p2: Indlela Yokubhalisa Ibhizinisi Lakho: Iya ku-mapofpi.com → Xhuma ne-Pi Wallet → Engeza Ibhizinisi → Engeza izithombe, indawo, imikhiqizo → Amakhasimende azokuthola! Yile ndlela i-Afrika ezohola ngayo ekwamukelweni kwe-Pi.
ch5-p1: Inani Lokuvumelana Lomhlaba (GCV) likhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwangempela. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Leli nani lakhiwa ngamaphayona asebenzisa i-Pi ekuhwebeni kwangempela.
ch5-p2: Incazelo ye-GCV: I-GCV akuyona intengo yokushintshanisa. Kuyinhlangano yokuvikela inani le-Pi ngokusebenzisa i-Pi ekuvumelaneni okuphezulu ekushintshaneni kwethu. Uma sisebenzisa i-Pi ngezimpahla zangempela ku-GCV, sakha isidingo nokusetshenziswa. Lokhu kungukunika amandla kwezomnotho kwe-Afrika.
ch6-p1: Funda imanuwali ka-Doris Yin yokudala ukusetshenziswa kanye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem. Cwaninga, funda, futhi ufundise abanye — yilena ndlela esiqinisa ngayo i-Afrika.
ch6-p2: Indima Yakho NjengePhayona Lase-Afrika: Funda → Zijwayeze → Fundisa abantu abangu-2 → Laba abangu-2 bafundise abanye abangu-2. Yile ndlela esifinyelela ngayo ku-1 Million yama-Afrika afundile! Landa i-Whitepaper, funda, futhi wabelane ngolwazi nsuku zonke.
final-msg: I-Afrika inethuba lokuba esinye sezifunda ezinamandla kakhulu ekusetshenzisweni okungokoqobo ngaphakathi kwe-Pi Ecosystem. Sisonke Siyakha. Sisonke Siyafundisa.
